entries.proposition: Wwox^P47T/P47T mice show frequent interictal cortical spike discharges on video-EEG; the WT range and the mutant range do not overlap.
entries.snippet: We detected very frequent interictal cortical spike discharges (0–3098/hour)
entries.anchor: Results 2.3, 'WwoxP47T/P47T mice display chronic spontaneous generalized tonic-clonic seizures'

entries.proposition: Wild-type littermates show low-rate spike activity and NO seizures — the negative control for the mutant seizure counts.
entries.snippet: Wildtype mice displayed infrequent spike activity (0–68/hour) but no evidence of seizures
entries.anchor: Results 2.3, same paragraph as the mutant spike range

entries.proposition: Spontaneous convulsive seizures in the mutant are quantified over a defined monitoring window, not merely observed.
entries.snippet: repeated spontaneous generalized convulsive activity (11–22 seizures during 43–53 h monitoring periods)
entries.anchor: Results 2.3

entries.proposition: Every mutant animal seized repeatedly within 24 h — penetrance is complete at n=3, though n=3 is n=3.
entries.snippet: mutant mice had multiple (>4) seizures during a 24 h recording period
entries.anchor: Results 2.3, citing Supplementary Figs. S3a-b (NOT retrieved)

entries.proposition: ABUNDANCE/FUNCTION DISSOCIATION, transcript arm: P47T does not change Wwox mRNA level.
entries.snippet: CB were comparable, with no significant difference in n = 6 mice tested in each group
entries.anchor: Results 2.1, citing Supplementary Fig. S2a (NOT retrieved)

entries.proposition: ABUNDANCE/FUNCTION DISSOCIATION, protein arm: P47T does not change Wwox protein level. Read together with the pull-down locator, this is normal abundance with abolished function.
entries.snippet: Western blot analyses also showed similar levels of Wwox protein expression in homozygous mutant and wildtype mice
entries.anchor: Results 2.1. NOTE: the cited panel is the 10% input lane of a pull-down blot (Fig. 1a), not a dedicated quantified western

entries.proposition: The FUNCTION arm of the dissociation: the point mutation abolishes PPxY binding.
entries.snippet: p.Pro47Thr mutation is sufficient to abrogate Wwox affinity for PPxY motifs
entries.anchor: Fig. 1 legend (title line); pull-down with biotinylated Dvl2 and Wbp1 peptides, n=2/group

entries.proposition: METHODOLOGICAL SUPERIORITY over the only null ECoG dataset: animals were recovered before recording, whereas PMID 42422765 began acquisition immediately after surgery with no recovery interval.
entries.snippet: Mice were allowed to recover for 14 days before recording
entries.anchor: Methods 4.4 'Video electroencephalography (EEG)'

entries.proposition: The montage is bilateral and multi-region, so bilateral synchrony is resolvable — which a single-channel design cannot do.
entries.snippet: silver wire electrodes (0.005″ diameter) soldered to a connector were surgically implanted bilaterally into the subdural space over frontal and parietal cortex
entries.anchor: Methods 4.4

entries.proposition: EEG reading was by two observers but blinding is NOT declared — a weaker declaration than PMID 42422765, which declares a blinded reader.
entries.snippet: EEGs were reviewed by two trained observers
entries.anchor: Methods 4.4, final sentence

entries.proposition: HETEROZYGOTE IS NAMED IN A POSITIVE FINDING: P47T/WT animals are not phenotype-free, which bounds any transfer to CLAIM 032.
entries.snippet: mice displayed signs of cholestasis with enlarged gallbladders, and a few animals had evidence of focal liver degeneration
entries.anchor: Results 2.2, citing Supplementary Table 4 (NOT retrieved). The subject of the sentence is 'various WwoxP47T/P47T and WwoxP47T/WT mice'

entries.proposition: UNVERIFIABLE NEGATIVE: the heterozygote neuroinflammation negative is declared 'data not shown' and may not be cited as evidence of heterozygote normality.
entries.snippet: no differences were observed when compared with the wildtype mice (data not shown)
entries.anchor: Results 2.5, on Iba1/Gfap immunostaining in WwoxP47T/WT brains

entries.proposition: Transcriptomic GABA finding is an EXPRESSION PROGRAMME, not a measure of inhibition, and must not be recruited to the E_GABA sign question.
entries.snippet: Suppression of GABAergic and glutamatergic synapses in CTX and HPC was also detected in KEGG pathways
entries.anchor: Results 2.7, KEGG enrichment, citing Supplementary Figs. S11-12 (NOT retrieved)

entries.proposition: LONGEVITY, from the BODY not the abstract: the P47T knock-in is the only WWOX genotype in which adult electrophysiology is obtainable. Mean survival 393 days.
entries.snippet: showed a mean long-term survival of 393 days
entries.anchor: Results 2.2, survival paragraph, with Fig. 1b. The abstract's 'live beyond 1 year of age' is NOT used: it is abstract-only and the validator refused it.

entries.proposition: LONGEVITY IS SHORTENED, not merely long: 393 days for the homozygote against 495 for the heterozygote and 542 for wild type, log-rank p=0.001. A summary keeping only 'long-lived' drops the comparator.
entries.snippet: their life span was shorter compared to 495
entries.anchor: Results 2.2, immediately following the 393-day figure

entries.proposition: CLAIM 032 BOUNDARY: the P47T heterozygote's survival is REDUCED but NOT SIGNIFICANTLY so — a non-significant trend, which is not the same as a demonstrated null, and the paper reports no power for it.
entries.snippet: but the difference was not statistically significance
entries.anchor: Results 2.2. Full clause: WwoxP47T/WT mice also displayed a reduced overall survival in comparison to the WwoxWT/WT. Grammatical slip is the source's, preserved verbatim

entries.proposition: UPSTREAM_CITATION_FAILURE instance: the null-mouse seizure assertion is cited to a human study, a review, and a mouse paper that measured no seizures.
entries.snippet: Like WOREE children, Wwox-KO mice displayed spontaneous seizures, motor deficits, ultimately reaching almost total immobility, and a short lifespan (~3 weeks)
entries.anchor: Discussion. Its three citations resolve to Mallaret 2014 (human patients), Aldaz/Ferguson/Abba 2014 BBA (review), and Ludes-Meyers 2009 PMID 19936220, which per LEGEND complete read contains no seizure measurement

entries.proposition: ABUNDANCE/FUNCTION DISSOCIATION attested from the image: binding is abolished while protein level is not.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 1a: Anti-Wwox Dvl2 pulldown and Anti-Wwox Wbp1 pulldown show strong bands in WT/WT and near-absent bands in P47T/P47T, while Anti-Wwox 10% input shows comparable bands in BOTH genotypes; Anti-Hsp90 and both Anti-Biotin peptide-bead inputs are comparable. Two lanes per genotype.
entries.anchor: Figure 1, panel a, native resolution 1801x1412. The abundance evidence is an input lane of a pull-down blot, not a dedicated quantified western; n=2 per genotype is visible as two lanes.

entries.proposition: SURVIVAL CURVE CONTRADICTS THE RUNNING TEXT'S MEAN: a quarter of homozygotes are alive at the last plotted day, and wild type is not flat at 1.0.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 1b: x-axis runs to 600 days. WT/WT (n=14) approx 1.0 until ~500d then ~0.90. P47T/WT (n=30) ~0.93 to ~430d, declining to ~0.75 by ~520d. P47T/P47T (n=25) ~0.62 at 350d, ~0.53 at ~470d, ~0.26 still alive at ~580d. Log-rank p=0.001.
entries.anchor: Figure 1, panel b. The text's 'mean long-term survival of 393 +/- 32 days' is not reconcilable at face value with a 50% crossing near 470-500d; a mean over decedents only would explain it but is not stated.

entries.proposition: BILATERAL SYNCHRONY of epileptiform activity is attested from the image, not inferred from the montage description.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 1d: four channels labelled L-f, R-f, L-p, R-p; scale 500 microvolt / 1 s. Trace i (WT/WT) low-amplitude background; trace ii (P47T/P47T) frequent high-amplitude interictal spikes synchronous across all four channels; trace iii a generalized discharge, abrupt spike then fast rhythmic evolving to arrhythmic, across all four.
entries.anchor: Figure 1, panel d. This is the property a single-channel epidural montage (PMID 42422765) cannot resolve.

entries.proposition: MICROGLIOSIS IS NOT PROGRESSIVE IN ABUNDANCE: Iba1+ cell number is identical at 80 and 250 days, and no within-genotype age bracket is drawn.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 3b: WT ~22 vs P47T/P47T ~34 at 80-days (*), and WT ~22 vs P47T/P47T ~34 at 250-days (*). No significance bracket connects the two mutant ages. Fig 3c area fraction: mutant ~21 at 80d and ~20.5 at 250d while WT falls ~14.5 to ~11, so the widening gap is driven by the control.
entries.anchor: Figure 3, panels b and c, native resolution 1531x2100. Contrast Fig 3e-g where within-genotype 80-vs-250 brackets ARE drawn.

entries.proposition: MICROGLIAL MORPHOLOGY IS progressive, and it is the only microglial measure that is.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 3e branches: mutant ~60 at 80d to ~40 at 250d with a significance bracket between the two mutant ages. Fig 3f junctions ~30 to ~20 with bracket. Fig 3g total branch length ~315 to ~220 with bracket.
entries.anchor: Figure 3, panels e, f, g.

entries.proposition: ASTROGLIOSIS IS GENUINELY PROGRESSIVE, in both number and area, with within-genotype significance.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 4b: Gfap+ number WT ~27 vs mutant ~39 at 80d (*), WT ~27 vs mutant ~56 at 250d (*), plus a significance bracket between the two mutant ages. Fig 4c: area fraction mutant ~24 at 80d to ~40 at 250d, also bracketed.
entries.anchor: Figure 4, panels b and c, native resolution 1430x2100.

entries.proposition: OLIGODENDROCYTE LOSS is established early and does not progress.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 4e: Olig2+ cells WT ~205 vs mutant ~122 at 80-days (*), WT ~235 vs mutant ~117 at 250-days (*). No within-genotype bracket between mutant ages.
entries.anchor: Figure 4, panel e.

entries.proposition: CEREBELLAR NEURONAL LOSS IS EARLY AND NOT PROGRESSIVE, and it is cell-type selective: basket cells are spared at both ages.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 5d: Purkinje number WT ~95 vs mutant ~25 at 80-days (*); WT ~100 vs mutant ~42 at 250-days (*) - the mutant value is HIGHER at the later age, and no within-genotype bracket is drawn. Fig 5e: basket cell number is ns at BOTH 80 and 250 days.
entries.anchor: Figure 5, panels d and e, native resolution 1542x2100. The apparent Purkinje increase is most likely survivor selection in the 250-day cohort; the panels do not decide between that and recovery.

entries.proposition: THE WIDENING CEREBELLAR LAYER DIFFERENCE IS PARTLY NORMAL WILD-TYPE GROWTH, not only mutant loss.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 5g molecular layer thickness: WT ~190 at 80d rising to ~222 at 250d, while mutant is flat ~165 to ~162, both comparisons (*). Fig 5h granular layer: WT ~103 to ~130, mutant ~90 to ~92, both (*).
entries.anchor: Figure 5, panels g and h.
